title: ARGOS Exercise Metadata
description: Metadata for an ARGOS exercise, which includes information about the exercise such as its name, description, and it's difficulty.

description.description: A brief description of the exercise.

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the exercise. It can be one of 'easy', 'medium', or 'hard'.

language.description: The programming language used in the exercise. It can be one of 'c', 'cpp'.

skills.description: The skills that the exercise covers. Snake_case keys defined in skills.labels.json.
